chosen.label: Lyric sheet
chosen.note: From the CHOSEN song lyric sheet. Rehearse against the audio for any arrangement changes.

sections.heading: VERSE 1
sections.text:
I knew the road to the well,
I knew the shape of the day,
I knew the life I was promised
Would not be taken away.


I knew the voice of my mother,
I knew the work of my hands,
I knew the quiet kind of future
A girl like me could plan.


Then the air begins to tremble,
Then the light begins to rise,
And a messenger of heaven
Is standing before my eyes.

sections.heading: PRE-CHORUS 1
sections.text:
And I want to run,
I want to hide,
But somehow Your voice
Is already inside.

sections.heading: CHORUS 1
sections.text:
Chosen,
Not ready, not strong,
I don’t know where this road will lead,
But I hear You calling.


Chosen,
Can that be my name?
Can heaven ask these hands of mine
To hold what I can’t name?


I am afraid,
But I am listening.
Could I be chosen?

sections.heading: VERSE 2
sections.text:
What will Joseph see
When he looks into my eyes?
Will he hear the truth in me,
Or only hear the lies?


What will the village say
When the whispers start to grow?
How do I carry heaven
When no one else can know?


I thought faith was something steady,
Like a lamp beside the door.
Now it feels like stepping forward
Where there is no floor.

sections.heading: PRE-CHORUS 2
sections.text:
How can this be?
How can this be?
I am small,
But still You see me.

sections.heading: CHORUS 2
sections.text:
Chosen,
Not ready, not strong,
I don’t know what this yes will cost,
But I hear You calling.


Chosen,
Is this why You came?
Can mercy ask a life like mine
To never be the same?


I am afraid,
But I am still listening.
Could I be chosen?

sections.heading: BRIDGE
sections.text:
I give You the wedding.
I give You the name.
I give You the future
I had already claimed.


I give You the questions.
I give You the cost.
I give You the life
I thought was my own.


If faith is one step
Before the road is shown,
Then I will take it trembling,
But I will not walk alone.

sections.heading: FINAL CHORUS
sections.text:
Chosen,
Not because I understand.
Chosen,
Not because I know the plan.


But if You are the One who calls me,
I will trust the One who knows.
Let the world misunderstand me,
Still my answer will be Yours.


I am afraid,
But I am willing.
I am Yours.
I am chosen.

sections.heading: TAG
sections.text:
Let it be as You have spoken.
I am Yours.
I am chosen.

still-yours.label: Current script lyric
still-yours.note: Includes the spoken Middle 8 and hand exchange within the song.

sections.heading: Verse 1: Joseph
sections.text:
I had a road.
I had a room.
I had a table in my mind.
I had a roof
I meant to raise,
A future measured out in lines.
I held the plan so tightly,
I could not hear your pain.
When your truth stood at my doorway,
I shut the door again.
I cannot make them quiet.
I cannot make this right.
But I can stand beside you
Through the staring and the night.

sections.heading: Verse 2: Mary
sections.text:
You made me a promise.
I wore it like a shawl.
When the whispers found my window,
I had nothing warm at all.
I carried heaven’s answer
And watched your face turn cold.
You waited for an angel
When you had me to hold.
I do not need a hero.
I do not need a shield.
I need truth that stays beside me
When the whole town knows what’s real.

sections.heading: Chorus: Joseph, Mary, Both
sections.text:
Joseph
Still, still yours,
If you’ll let me be.
Mary
Still, still mine?
Can I believe what I see?
Both
Not the house we imagined,
Not the life we rehearsed,
But a hand can be offered
Where a heart has been hurt.
Joseph
I am still here.
Mary
Still here.
Both
Still yours.

sections.heading: Middle 8: spoken call and response
sections.text:
Joseph
I won’t speak over you.
Mary
Then don’t.
Joseph
I won’t stand in front of you.
Mary
Then stand close.
Joseph
I won’t answer for you.
Mary
Then listen.
Joseph
I won’t carry this for you.
Mary
You can’t.
Joseph
But I can carry it with you.
Mary
Then stay.
Joseph
I’ll stay.

sections.heading: Bridge: spoken hand exchange, then sung
sections.text:
Joseph
Here is my hand.
Only if you want it.
Mary
Leave it there.
Let me come to it.
Joseph
I will not take.
Mary
I will not hide.
Both
Love is not the road we pictured.
Love is choosing side by side.

sections.heading: Final Chorus
sections.text:
Both
Still, still yours,
With the whispers at the door.
Still, still yours,
Not the way we were before.
Not the house we imagined,
Not the life we rehearsed,
But a hand can be offered
Where a heart has been hurt.
Mary
Not because it’s easy.
Joseph
Not because it’s clear.
Both
But because we choose it
Here.

sections.heading: Break
sections.text:
Joseph
Whatever comes...
Mary
Whatever comes...
Both
We’ll walk together.
Hand in hand,
Breath by breath,
Still afraid,
Still unsure,
Still I choose you.
Still yours.

sections.heading: Tag
sections.text:
Joseph
Still yours.
Mary
Still yours.
Both
Still yours.

chosen-finale.label: Current script lyric
chosen-finale.note: From the current Scene 12 finale. The Wise Men and dance staging continue around the song.

sections.heading: Verse — warm, intimate
sections.text:
From an ordinary place,
Underneath a quiet sky,
Heaven kept a promise,
And the Light of hope arrived.
No throne, no grand procession,
Just a child beneath a star.
God called ordinary people
And met them where they are.

sections.heading: Chorus — begin to open
sections.text:
Chosen to believe,
Chosen to say yes,
Chosen to keep walking
When we cannot see what’s next.
Chosen to carry hope,
Chosen to carry light.
The story didn’t end in Bethlehem—
His love still shines tonight.

sections.heading: Bridge — stronger rhythmic build
sections.text:
They didn’t know the road—
Still they said yes.
They didn’t know the cost—
Still they said yes.
Through every fear and question,
They chose to trust His voice.
They were chosen for the calling,
And they answered with a choice.

sections.heading: Final Chorus — Full Company
sections.text:
Chosen to believe,
Chosen to say yes,
Chosen to keep walking
When we cannot see what’s next.
Chosen to carry hope,
Chosen to carry light.
The story didn’t end in Bethlehem—
We are chosen to carry the Light.

sections.heading: Final Tag
sections.text:
The promise has come.
The Savior is here.
Now His calling is ours to hear.
They were chosen.
We are chosen.
And so are you.
Chosen to love.
Chosen to serve.
Chosen to carry His light.

sections.heading: Final sustained word
sections.text: Chosen.
